newsitem.title: UK: Nigeria oil officials visiting London next week.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria oil officials visiting London next week.

text.p: A delegation from Nigeria will visit London next week to discuss the relocation of state Nigerian National Petroleum Company's (NNPC) European trading operations, a company official said on Wednesday.
Nigerian Oil Minister Dan Etete on Tuesday ordered the London NNPC office's immediate closure citing financial reasons.
The delegation arriving next Tuesday is to include members of Nigeria's Ministry of Petroleum Resources, as well as high-level NNPC officials, the official said.
The Nigerian government on Tuesday indicated that a smaller, coordinated office would soon be established elsewhere in Europe, but was not specific as to the city.

A Nigerian newspaper speculated on Wednesday that Vienna was high on the list of potential destinations because the Organisation of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC), to which Nigeria belongs, holds its semi-annual meetings there. But NNPC said no firm plans were in place.
The NNPC London office, which is headed by a general manager and employs 16 Nigerian staff, monitors Nigeria's oil transactions with European customers.
Nigeria's oil trading activities have a sizeable impact on Mediterranean spot markets.

NNPC exports about half of Nigeria's total oil exports via contracts with trading companies and refiners. The other half is in the hands of the main joint venture production companies which operate in the country.
